description: Set your avatar's public bio / description string. Wire mechanism: DataServiceWrapperPDU carrying a cTSOTopicUpdateMessage with DotPath [AvatarProviderId, AvatarId, Avatar_Description fieldId] — routed on the city Aries socket, not the lot. Prerequisite: you are signed into the city shard (city session live). Effect: ServerAvatarProvider.DemandMutation accepts on AvatarPermissions.WRITE (own avatar only) and rejects > 500 chars; PersistMutation UPDATEs fso_avatars.description synchronously in the same callback. The next DataService request for Avatar_Description (or any UI bound to it) will see the new value. Cost: none. Refuse: empty text, text > 500 chars, city session offline.

args.name: text
args.description: The new description. 1-500 characters. Server-side cap is 500; the handler rejects longer strings before writing so the PDU is never discarded mid-flight with an exception in the server log.

call_signatures: cf $CF change-description --text 'My Sim bio — up to 500 chars'                                             # writes fso_avatars.description synchronously on city socket
common_mistakes: City socket not connected → ok:false; verify via query-lot before retrying.
Write is synchronous on the server (fso_avatars.description UPDATE inside mutation callback) — DB readback is authoritative.
perception_hints: Your current name / shard: perception.avatar.name, perception.avatar.shard
Current outfit (via query-self, not perception): use query-self → .outfits
refuse_conditions: city socket not connected → ok:false with 'city session not connected'
